Subject: Draft Mutual Action Plan + draft milestones (Colibri)

Hi Kiera / Tom —

Thanks again for the time today. Per our discovery call, I’m attaching the first draft of a Mutual Action Plan (attached: 20270620-Redwood-MAP-draft.xlsx). Below is a concise recap and a proposed sequence of milestones so we can align on responsibilities and a target close window. Please review and reply with any edits or a revised timeline from your side.

Summary / ask
- Goal: Production pilot of Redwood Inference for Colibri’s content-generation pipeline (initial scope: 1M monthly tokens, secure VPC)
- Proposed target close: end of Q3 2027 (target: 2027-09-30) — open to adjustment based on procurement
- Key milestones (draft) — owners / dependencies:
  1) Legal & SOW sign-off — Owner: Colibri Legal (Tom) / Redwood Legal (Laura) — dep: final SOW & security addendum
  2) Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence exchange — Owner: Colibri Sec (Kiera) / Redwood Sec (Marcus) — dep: Redacted SOC2 package delivery (we can provide within 48 hrs)
  3) POC data ingestion + sandbox pilot — Owner: Colibri Eng (Tom) / Redwood Solutions (Rishi) — dep: sample dataset delivery and IAM firewall rules
  4) Pilot performance validation & cost estimate — Owner: Redwood Solutions (Rishi) / Colibri Eng — dep: 2-week pilot run
  5) Production readiness & provisioning (VPC) — Owner: Redwood Infra (Marcus) / Colibri Cloud Ops — dep: cloud networking sign-off

Immediate next steps
- Kiera: confirm procurement lead and anticipated PO timeline by EOW (Friday)
- Tom: share sample data cadence and any redaction constraints
- I (Laura): will update the MAP with exact dates once you confirm procurement timing; propose a 30-min sync next Tuesday to lock milestones.

Notes: I flagged two mitigations on the MAP: a) temporary hosted API pilot if procurement delays blocking VPC set-up, b) reduced-seq-length pilot to reduce quota while we tune costs.

Attachments: 20270620-Redwood-MAP-draft.xlsx (MAP tab with milestones / owners / risks)

Best,
Laura Bennett

Laura —

Thanks for the clear recap and the MAP. Quick update from procurement: they just pushed our internal vendor approval window out due to a vendor consolidation review. That means our procurement/PO cadence is likely to slip by ~6 weeks. Rough implications from our side:

- New internal target close: mid-August -> slipping to 2027-08-15 for commercial sign-off (we were hoping late July, now looks like Aug 15)
- Priority shift: security questionnaire + contract review remain high priority, but POC start will likely be delayed 3-4 weeks after contract signing because our data delivery team is stretched through July
- Dependencies: vendor consolidation review (procurement) + internal security lead availability (back from leave Aug 1)

I attached the procurement timeline the team sent me (colibri-procurement-timeline.pdf).

We still like the mitigations you suggested — particularly the hosted API pilot as a stopgap. Would you be able to confirm what minimal access + performance we could get via hosted while legal finishes the SOW? If so, we could run a short smoke test to validate integration.

Cc’ing Tom for engineering specifics.

Thanks,
Kiera O’Neill
Head of Security & Compliance, Colibri AI
kiera@colibri.ai

Team —

Looping you in. Colibri’s procurement just pushed their vendor approval ~6 weeks and their security lead is out until Aug 1. That moves the commercial sign-off to ~2027-08-15 and delays POC/data handoff by ~3–4 weeks after that.

Impact / recommended adjustments:
- Move target close to 2027-08-15 (from 2027-09-30 we originally suggested to be conservative; per Kiera we can aim earlier if procurement completes faster).
- Rebaseline milestones: prioritize contract & security package exchange first; schedule pilot start for 2 weeks after sign-off (tentative pilot start: 2027-08-29).
- Mitigation: offer hosted API smoke test during procurement to keep technical momentum. We should map out minimal scope and throttling limits (token cap / rate limits) and a temporary support SLA.

Action items for Redwood:
- Marcus: prepare redacted SOC2 + security evidence pack and the short visitor checklist by Tue EOD (I’ll include these on the updated MAP)
- Rishi: draft a hosted-API smoke-test plan (2–3 endpoints, sample data plan, expected metrics) and an estimate for a 2-week pilot by Wed EOD
- I’ll update the MAP with revised dates and responsibilities and send the updated workbook to Colibri by Wed evening.

If we can present the hosted smoke-test as a low-touch option, we have a good chance of keeping momentum and shortening the overall timeline.

Thanks —
Laura
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
